target: tracker.sh reconcile-done — with no forge.sh beside tracker.sh (pre-spec scaffold) the gh pr view fallback behaves as before
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://github.com/o/r.git
mkdir -p factory/specs scripts/lib
cp "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/obs.sh" scripts/lib/
[[ -e scripts/lib/forge.sh ]] && echo sandbox_has_forge=yes || echo sandbox_has_forge=no
git checkout -q -b claude/idea-x; git commit -q --allow-empty -m w; git checkout -q main
reset() { printf -- '---\nid: 001\ntitle: t\nstatus: pr-open\nbranch: claude/idea-x\npr: https://github.com/o/r/pull/5\n---\n' > factory/specs/001-s.md; }
reset; fx_gh pr_view 0 MERGED
bash scripts/lib/tracker.sh reconcile-done tester >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "merged=$(sed -n 's/^status: //p' factory/specs/001-s.md | head -1)"
reset; fx_gh pr_view 0 OPEN
bash scripts/lib/tracker.sh reconcile-done tester >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "open=$(sed -n 's/^status: //p' factory/specs/001-s.md | head -1)"
echo "gh_views=$(fx_count gh pr view)"; echo "curl_calls=$(grep -c '^curl' "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/calls.log" 2>/dev/null)"; fx_calls_text
[[ -x "$F" ]] && echo plugin_has_forge=yes && fx_done
exit 127
